changelog:
Interact with your Toggl Track time tracking workspace via the toggl-cli. Start/stop timers, manage time entries, projects, clients, and tags directly from the command line.

Start by creating an account on https://track.toggl.com/
display_name: Toggl CLI – Time tracking for you and your agent
summary: Control your Toggl Track workspace via CLI to manage time entries, projects, clients, tasks, tags, workspaces, and user profiles with flexible commands.
